borders.label: 边框 6 - Border 6
borders.description: The content surfaces outside the sidebar are clean white (`#FFFFFF`) in light mode or a near-black canvas (`#1A1D21`) in dark mode, giving Slack a two-zone visual structure: the saturated workspace sidebar on one side, the neutral conversation canvas on the other. Channel names (`#design`, `#general`) appear in the sidebar in a muted lavender-white (`#CFC3CF`) with full-white on the active channel. Unread channels get the bold treatment — channel name shifts to `#FFFFFF` bold, and a small count badge (for direct mentions) appears in bright red (`#E01E5A`, another Slack signature hue).

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use Slack Aubergine ({#4A154B}) as the default sidebar color — it's the signature brand anchor。
建议：Make sidebar color workspace-customizable (admin setting) — allow any hex。
建议：Use rounded-square (4pt corner) avatars — NOT circles — Slack's distinct choice。
建议：Surface reactions below every message as inline pill chips with emoji + count。
建议：Show threads as first-class: "5 replies, last reply 3h ago" link + slide-in pane on tap。
dont: 避免：use circle avatars — rounded-square (4pt) is Slack's signature。
避免：hardcode the sidebar color — it's workspace-customizable。
避免：use Slack aubergine anywhere except the sidebar (and login screens) — it's the sidebar's color。
避免：put mentions without the colored pill background — the pill IS the mention。
避免：ignore threads — they need a sliding pane, not a tap-through replacement of the main view。
